entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-03
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Move some of the Design services to Relational #37293
    11.0.0
  • Consider a common/unified hybrid search query API #37292
    11.0.0
  • Consider a common/unified full-text search API #37291
    11.0.0
  • Consider deprecating relational owned JSON support #37290
    11.0.0
  • Deprecate owned types with ordinal keys (owned JSON collections) #37289
    11.0.0
  • GroupJoin in EF Core 9/10 returns single row for SQL Server temporal tables #37288

Closed

  • Unable to use (Sql)Parameter with FromSqlRaw with Cosmos DB #37252
    10.0.2
  • Disconnected change tracker instance graph failing to commit anything #37276
  • FromSql with complex type property results in the NullReferenceException #37222
    10.0.2

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix TableSharingConcurrencyTokenConvention to skip JSON-mapped entity types #37287

Merged

  • [release/10.0] Fix Cosmos parameter naming for FromSql and regular parameters #37273
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.2
  • [release/10.0] Make FromSql work on entity types containing complex JSON #37235
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.2

Updated

  • [release/10.0] Fix snapshot generation to capture column type for JSON columns #37284
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37285
  • [release/10.0] Fix TableSharingConcurrencyTokenConvention to skip JSON-mapped entities #37286
  • Fallback to OPENJSON with many parameters #37234
  • [release/10.0] Always generate HasDiscriminator with type argument and property name in snapshot #37242
